name: Install apps your agent builds
author: wizard
description: When your agent builds an app for you, it ends with an install link instead of a terminal command. The App Manager (wam/agent_builds.py) finds the app on this Wizard, checks exactly the copy the link names (refused once a file changed, or when it asks for host access) and installs or updates it when you tap. Box-side switch: the App Manager reads it.
